logline: While feigning submission after her public humiliation, Catherine schemes in secret, plotting to use the council's ten-day reprieve to strike back at Alexander and Juliana with the aid of Father Thomas.

moments.description: Catherine stands by her window silhouetted in the moonlight, delivering a cold threat about the healer's crown.
moments.key_dialogue: Two words, and that healer's crown rolls right back into the gutter where it belongs.

moments.description: Catherine clenches her fist, vowing that the ten-day reprieve given by Alexander is a door she will use to strike back.
moments.key_dialogue: Ten days is not a wall, Alexander. It's a door.

moments.description: Catherine grabs her maid Agnes by the hands and embraces her public humiliation as a tool for vengeance.
moments.key_dialogue: Grief makes people careless, and carelessness is exactly what I need from that household right now.

moments.description: Catherine plots her next manipulative move involving Father Thomas to undermine the upcoming hearing.
moments.key_dialogue: Father Thomas did his part beautifully today.

moments.description: Catherine hands Agnes a heavy pouch of gold coins, commanding her to secretly summon the priest into the chambers tonight.
